SELECT o.login_state, o.status, (o.member_key IS NULL) AS order_mk_null, (f.member_key IS NULL) AS line_mk_null, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS orders, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_web_order o JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.dispatch_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01' AND o.dispatch_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts_utc) AS m, count(*) AS lines, sum(CASE WHEN o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loggedin_null_line,
 sum(CASE WHEN o.login_state='logged_in' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loggedin_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN o.login_state='guest' AND f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guest_with_key,
 count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS minload, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS maxload
FROM fact_web_order o JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01' AND o.order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT min(o.order_ts_utc) AS first_bad, max(o.order_ts_utc) AS last_bad, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS bad_orders,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order o2 JOIN fact_sales_line f2 ON f2.receipt_id=o2.web_order_id WHERE f2.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f2.member_key<>o2.member_key) AS mismatched_keys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE login_state='logged_in' AND member_key IS NULL) AS loggedin_order_null,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE login_state='guest' AND member_key IS NOT NULL) AS guest_order_key
FROM fact_web_order o JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.member_key AS line_member_key, w.order_member_key, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS web_net_sales_before_returns,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_web_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS member_share_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.line_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS uncorrected_pct
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

calls.statement:
WITH wd AS (
 SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
mine AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_period, s.store_id, p.category='ZZ Test' AS is_test, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=wd.dd
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY ALL),
ctrl AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctrl_before, sum(r.returns_net) AS ctrl_returns
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
 WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, m.store_id, m.is_test, m.net, c.ctrl_before, c.ctrl_returns FROM mine m LEFT JOIN ctrl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1,2,3
